title: EmailSubmission/set update: any field patchable, not just undoStatus
description: submission.rs process_update checks whether the current undoStatus is Final (to reject unsend), but does NOT validate that the patch only contains 'undoStatus'. RFC 8621 §7.5: 'Only the undoStatus property may be changed.' A client can currently patch emailId, identityId, deliveryStatus, etc. and the backend will apply it. Fix: reject the update with invalidProperties if the patch keys include anything other than 'undoStatus'.
